newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania to discuss reconstruction in Italy talks.
newsitem.headline: Albania to discuss reconstruction in Italy talks.

text.p: Albania's new Prime Minister Fatos Nano left for Italy on Wednesday to attend an international donors' conference discussing how to rebuild the shattered country.

"We shall define the priorities of our work, the framework of talks with world institutions and ways of communicating with donors, banks and other governments...so that our programme can be applied immediately," Nano told reporters at the airport.

Albania is seeking international assistance to rebuild state structures destroyed during months of violent unrest that followed the collapse of fraudulent pyramid investment schemes earlier this year.
"This is a preparatory conference for a high-level donors' conference in October. It will decide the priorities for the areas and types of international assistance," spokesman Vladimir Prela said.

The demise of pyramid schemes sparked widespread violence in Europe's poorest state and led to the ousting of the right-leaning Democratic Party government and the resignation of president Sali Berisha. More than 1,500 people have died.
The new Socialist-led government won a parliamentary confidence vote on Tuesday for its programme to restore order and revive Albania's shattered economy.
Nano will meet Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi and hold roundtable talks with ministers.
